name: Reserve generation three and produce one native spy after the test Civic grants capacity three

condition.code: local p=Players[0]; local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and b and type(b.ThirdSpyReserve)=='function'

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.ThirdSpyReserve('BEGIN'); return 'third generation snapshot and BUILD reservation queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.thirdLast; if a=='ERROR_BEGIN' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_BEGIN'
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BUILD_SPY' or a=='REJECTED_BUILD_SPY' then error(a) end; return a=='READY_BUILD_SPY'
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_PROGRESS_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; local p=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PROGRESS'); return p and p.generation==3

steps.code: local p=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PRODUCTION')); assert(p.generation==3 and p.progressed and p.beforeCount==0); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_THIRD_SPY_ARCHIVE')); return 'THIRD_PRODUCTION_QUEUED'
